Title: Azure Security Center: General availability updates for February 2021

Body.Content:
In February 2021, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure Security Center:

  • New security alerts page in the Azure portal released for general availability
  • Kubernetes workload protection recommendations released for general availability
  • Direct link to policy from recommendation details page
  • SQL data classification recommendation no longer affects your secure score
  • Asset inventory page enhancements

See the public preview updates for February 2021 here.
